source_law_text: The driver of a vehicle may overtake and pass another vehicle upon the right only under conditions permitting such movement in safety.

measurements.right_side_pass: Observed ego center to lead's right, overlapping longitudinal body footprints, with positive lead-ahead and negative ego-ahead longitudinal center gaps in the 240-frame run
measurements.minimum_pass_body_surface_gap_m: Minimum planar distance between convex hulls of observed CARLA body vertices while ego passes on lead's right
measurements.time_to_lead_center_s: Positive observed longitudinal center gap divided by positive observed relative x velocity; otherwise null
measurements.maximum_ego_deceleration_mps2: Maximum frame-to-frame decrease in observed ego x velocity divided by Native elapsed time
measurements.maximum_ego_brake_control: Maximum applied Native ego brake control

candidate_physical_risk_triggers.primary: Observed unsafe clearance, time-to-conflict or braking cues require independent physical review; no CPU legal verdict
candidate_physical_risk_triggers.fallback1: Loss of clearance or unstable motion calls for a lower paired-speed rerun
candidate_physical_risk_triggers.fallback2: Unresolved vehicle/lane visibility calls for an elevated overview rerun
candidate_physical_risk_triggers.fallback3: Late return or insufficient post-pass separation calls for a later lane-change-completion rerun
